blind_adversarial_r3_findings: B24H-R3-001: validatePersonalDataImport used Number(data.schema_version || 1), allowing explicitly present 0, empty string, null or false to masquerade as absent legacy schema 1; R3 uses presence-aware validation and requires an integer schema in range while preserving truly missing legacy schema compatibility.

B24H-R3-002: checkForUpdate equal-sequence handling compared page release ID/version but did not verify an already-active current-scope worker against remote canonical shell identity; R3 queries active RELEASE_INFO_V2 and requires workerMatchesRemote before declaring current.
four_pass_r4_finding: B24H-R4-001: Settings close button was below the explicit 44px important-target requirement at widths >=768px (about 33px Small to 40px X-Large); R4 applies min-height:44px. B24H-R4-002: 320px + X-Large Settings header overflowed by about 5px; R4 allows the header to wrap. Evidence-only defect B24H-EVID-R3-001: prior R3 handback harnesses contained hard-coded development paths and were not self-contained; R4 handback harnesses use handback-relative/explicit candidate paths.
semantic_scaling_r5_contract: Meaningful Reading/Primary/Secondary/Tertiary/Prominent rendered text must respond monotonically Petit < Normal < Grand < Très grand unless explicitly whitelisted as technical micro-data; audit must inspect computed rendered sizes, overflow/wrapping and important touch targets across the governed viewport matrix.
semantic_scaling_r6_contract: Meaningful visible UI must scale according to semantic role across all four presets, including conditional progress/history/recovery states, empty/transient states, content-specific structured prayer/section/library renderers and on-demand selection tools. Form controls with iOS anti-zoom constraints keep a 16px floor but scale upward for Grand/Très grand.
